dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately falcate trailing edge with a concave spline curvature from the apex to the insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a medium-radius obtuse curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree steepness relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 base width to vertical height ratio.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow convex curve with a large radius sloping toward the anterior point.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, low-profile beak with high thickness-to-length pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse inflection point, roughly 165 degrees at the transition from melon to rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan luminescence and lack of biological countershading; visible pectoral fins with sharp leading edges.
